summary: The filing is an 8-K reporting the entry into an underwriting agreement for a registered debt issuance. On June 1, 2026, Consolidated Edison Company of New York, Inc. sold $450M of 5.15% Debentures due 2036 and $850M of 5.875% Debentures due 2056 via underwriters J.P. Morgan, Mizuho, PNC, and Wells Fargo. The offering was made under an existing shelf registration (Form S-3). This is a routine debt offering with no special-situation characteristics; no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or strategic review is involved. The filing contains only the underwriting agreement, forms of debentures, and legal opinions, representing standard capital markets activity.
